# Readability.js (vendored)

`Readability.js` is Mozilla's article extractor, the one behind Firefox's Reader
View. Package `@mozilla/readability` 0.6.0, unmodified. Licensed Apache-2.0 (see
`LICENSE`), compatible with this project's Apache-2.0.

Used by the built-in browser's reader mode (`browser.rs`, op `reader`) and by the
agent's clean-text extraction of a page (op `extract`). To update: replace the
file with the same one from npm and note the version here.
